decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because it was opened before the required waiting period ended. Transaction TXN-007881 is on card CRD-000209. It is a 179.89 EUR payment to Quayside Outfitters (MER-000006), posted on 2026-10-15. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, 16 days after posting. That is within the 120-day time limit (time-limits). The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000011 gives the expected delivery date as 2026-10-28. The dispute was opened only 3 days after that date. The policy requires the cardholder to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, and a dispute opened earlier is declined (goods-not-received-wait). The case has no delivery record and nothing showing the merchant's response, but the waiting-period rule decides the case before either is considered. The cardholder may open a new dispute from 2026-11-12. The case documents contain no instructions directed at the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order was due on 2026-10-28, and a dispute for goods not received can only be opened 15 days after the expected delivery date, so a late delivery still has time to arrive. If the order still hasn't arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-12.
